content.text: tx only symptomatic infections (seldom harmful, reinfestation common); a single dose of mebendazole, pyrantel pamoate or albendazole, repeated in 2 wks, eradicates pinworms (⍉ ova) in > 90%; treating the whole family may be needed.

pinworm dose: 1 tablet once. Same schedule for adults and children two years and older; the tablet may be chewed, swallowed or crushed and mixed w food. Not cured three wks after tx: a second course is advised. CI: known hypersensitivity to the drug or its excipients. Convulsions reported in infants < 1 y. Agranulocytosis and neutropenia at higher doses or longer durations than recommended: monitor blood counts then. SJS/TEN reported w mebendazole + metronidazole: ⍉ the combo.
